blurb: Air Maui offers helicopter tours showcasing Maui's geology, history, and wildlife with expert narration. Tours include scenic flights over West Maui, Molokai, and East Maui including Haleakalā and Hana coastline. Private charters allow custom routes and flexible experiences with doors on or doors off options.
